description: This Java class defines a singleton immutable implementation of the Entry interface representing a nonexistent cache entry with fixed behaviors.

classes.name: NonexistentEntry
classes.description: An immutable singleton class representing a nonexistent cache entry that throws exceptions or returns defaults upon method calls.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number for the nonexistent entry, which is the minimal long value.

methods.name: getValueOrThrow
methods.description: Throws NoSuchElementException indicating that no value exists for this entry.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Indicates that this entry does not exist, returning false.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NonexistentEntry, parameterized with a generic type T.
